rendererFacts: restaurant_view.gd enables native_composition_enabled by default and initializes native_world_layer.gd.
The normal room draw path renders visuals through the shared native world pass while recording hit data at screen roots.
native_world_layer.gd uses native_pixel_compositor.gd at NATIVE_CELL=256, retaining a shared camera origin and fractional grid offset.
native_pixel_compositor.gd makes a native viewport, four half-size reduction viewports via native_reduce2.gdshader, and presents through native_present.gdshader.

The retained texture_filter LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS declaration alone does not describe the new normal room consumer; there is composed native reduction and presentation. Gallery behavior is separately branched.
No Godot test is required for rock-wall-middle merely because this repository has a native restaurant renderer.
